**`tests/test_limiter.py`** — 16 tests: limits match spec, key format, countdown, empty-at-37, full-refill-in-1500 ms, continuous (not windowed) refill, burst cap, remaining header, 37 vs 74 burst, gold keeps 1500 ms, rejection body/header, retry window shrinking with accrued tokens, log record name/level/message, per-tenant and per-route isolation.

Two judgement calls worth flagging: header values are strings (`"36"`), not ints, since they model HTTP headers; and unknown tier names fall back to standard rather than raising, as the spec defines only two tiers. `docs/architecture.md`, the spec's background sections and `vendor/schema.json` are filler — no requirements in them, and `vendor/` is untouched.
